queries.sql: SELECT split_part(symbol, '.', 2) AS exchange, max(trade_date) AS max_date FROM public.futures_daily WHERE trade_date >= %(lo)s AND trade_date <= %(hi)s AND split_part(symbol, '.', 2) = ANY(%(exchanges)s) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
    trade_date,
    symbol AS contract,
    open::float AS open,
    high::float AS high,
    low::float AS low,
    close::float AS close,
    volume::float AS volume,
    oi::float AS oi,
    turnover::float AS turnover,
    settle::float AS settle
 FROM public.futures_daily WHERE 
    trade_date >= %(lo)s
      AND trade_date <= %(hi)s
      AND split_part(symbol, '.', 2) <> 'CFE'
 ORDER BY trade_date, symbol

SELECT to_char(trade_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.futures_daily WHERE 
    trade_date >= %(lo)s
      AND trade_date <= %(hi)s
      AND split_part(symbol, '.', 2) <> 'CFE'
 GROUP BY 1

SELECT exchange, trade_date, upper(contract_id) AS contract_id, product_id, product_name, open_fee, offset_fee, short_open_fee, short_offset_fee, fee_style, fee_scale, spec_buy_rate, spec_sell_rate, source_url, source_sha256, fetched_at FROM exchange_data.futures_settle_param WHERE trade_date = %(day)s AND exchange = ANY(%(exchanges)s)

SELECT "交易所代码" AS exchange, "交易日期" AS trade_date, upper("合约代码") AS contract_id, "合约乘数" AS multiplier, "最后日期" AS last_date, "涨停价" AS limit_up, "跌停价" AS limit_down FROM public.futures_contract_info WHERE "交易日期" = %(day)s AND "交易所代码" = ANY(%(exchanges)s)
